stories.title: Series Preview — Cubs Open 3-Game Road Trip at Arizona Diamondbacks
stories.angle: Mandatory series-preview slot (is_series_start_today=true). Cubs 75-56 at D-backs 69-62. Arizona is one game outside WC3 — this is a direct WC battle. 3 games at Chase Field (38-28 at home). 8:40 PM CT tonight.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Cubs head to Chase Field for a 3-game series vs the D-backs tonight.

Arizona is 69-62 — one game from a wild card spot. Cubs are 75-56 at WC1. This series is a 6-game swing in the NL standings.

8:40 PM CT. Gausman vs Merrill Kelly (5.37 ERA).

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Game Recap — Cubs 19, Mariners 2 (Happ + Ramírez Grand Slams)
stories.angle: Cubs ended 2-game walk-off losing streak with a 19-2 demolition. Happ grand slam (22nd HR, 5 RBI), Ramírez grand slam (5 RBI), PCA 33rd HR, Conforto 11th HR. 17 hits. Avoided sweep.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
The Cubs dropped two straight walk-off losses in Seattle. Then Sunday happened.

Ian Happ grand slam (22nd HR, 5 RBI). Pedro Ramírez grand slam (5 RBI). PCA's 33rd HR. Final: 19-2.

Two walk-offs, then 19 runs. This team doesn't fold.

#Cubs #FlyTheW #GoCubs

stories.title: Ian Happ + Pedro Ramírez — 4th Cubs Duo Ever With Grand Slams in Same Game
stories.angle: Historic franchise feat. Happ 22nd HR, Ramírez 5 RBI. Contract year Happ timing angle. Insight-aligned: pure stat story.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Ian Happ and Pedro Ramírez hit grand slams in the same game — the 4th Cubs duo in franchise history to do it.

Happ: 22nd HR, 5 RBI. Ramírez: 5 RBI. Ten RBI from two swings.

Contract year Happ is warming up at exactly the right time.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Pitching Matchup — Gausman vs Merrill Kelly Tonight
stories.angle: Cubs hold edge in Game 1 pitching matchup. Gausman 138 K and 1.27 WHIP vs Kelly's 5.37 ERA / 1.52 WHIP. Bold take: Cubs have the clear arm advantage tonight.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Tonight in Phoenix: Gausman vs Merrill Kelly (5.37 ERA, 1.52 WHIP).

Gausman isn't at his best this season but this matchup tilts the Cubs' way. Kelly is exactly the kind of starter you want to face in late August.

8:40 PM CT. Game 1. Advantage: Chicago.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Wild Card Watch — D-backs 1 Game Out, Cubs Lead by 6 Over Phillies
stories.angle: NL WC picture entering today. Cubs 75-56, D-backs 69-62. Tonight's opponent is the closest WC pursuer. A sweep here could effectively end Arizona's WC chances; a D-backs series win narrows the gap to 3 games.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
NL wild card standings entering Monday:

WC1: Cubs 75-56
WC2: Phillies 72-58
WC3: Padres 70-60
On the bubble: D-backs 69-62 (tonight's opponent)

A Cubs sweep in Phoenix is worth more than just three wins. Arizona is hunting the same postseason spot.

#Cubs #MLB #NorthSiders

stories.title: Matt Shaw Rehab — On Track for September Callup
stories.angle: Shaw 2-for-4 with 2-RBI single for Iowa Aug 22. Counsell targets back-to-back rehab games this week, then activation. Stretch-run depth incoming.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Matt Shaw: 2-for-4 with a 2-RBI single for Iowa on Saturday.

Counsell wants back-to-back rehab starts this week — after that, September callup. Shaw hit .246/.322/.415 in 56 MLB games before the IL.

Depth incoming.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: First Pitch Hype — 8:40 PM CT at Chase Field
stories.angle: Game-time energy. Cubs enter as WC1, D-backs need this more. Gausman on the mound. Bold kicker.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
8:40 PM CT. Chase Field. Gausman on the mound.

Cubs are 75-56. The D-backs are 69-62 and need this series more than they'll admit.

Don't feed the snakes.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
